## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `77593a13e99ddb9a6ab56be6c87e812ee500472b`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #32992 (body and all 6 comments: filing, triage, area-A1 claim, area-A1 `os-dev-report` with its open question, area-A1 release 6882117393, ui claim 6883354532, ui `os-dev-report` 6884148625); PR #33436 body and file list (15 files); net diff `bd439f17..77593a13` (merge base = the base the dev measured on); the 60 check-runs on the head. Declared face: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` alone; no `packages/spec`, no governed path, no ADR or skill in the tree, so `TIER_DEFAULT` and no ④.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set changes (what a reader of a published package can now do or receive):
1. `@object-ui/i18n` locale packs — four new keys under `auth.login.errors` (`ssoAccessDenied`, `ssoSwitchAccount`, `ssoBackToConsole`, `ssoSwitchAccountHint`) in all eleven packs (en, de, es, fr, pt-BR, ru, ja, ko, ar, zh-Hans, zh-Hant; 44 added lines, nothing renamed or removed). **Right**: purely additive, the same four keys in every pack, so key parity holds; zh uses 本系统 (objectui#12956 rule) and de avoids „…“ (quote census), both stated and both re-run by the dev on the head.
2. `@object-ui/console` sign-in page — `?error=access_denied` now maps to its own sentence instead of the generic expired-link one (`SSO_CALLBACK_REFUSALS.access_denied`). **Right**: RFC 6749 §4.1.2.1 code, exactly what #33325's refusal redirect sends; every other code keeps its mapping, and the CONTROL case pins `invalid_provider` on the generic sentence.
3. `@object-ui/console` sign-in page — two new links under the banner, gated by `accessDeniedExits`: only for `access_denied`, only when `/auth/config` `features.cloudManaged === true`, only when the runtime config's `cloudUrl` is a non-empty absolute `http:`/`https:` URL (trailing slashes trimmed, anything else returns `null`). Switch account = `${base}/api/v1/auth/oauth2/end-session` (`target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`), Back to console = `base`. **Right**: the end-session door exists on the head (`plugin-auth/src/auth-route-ledger.ts` GET + POST + `/confirm`), it is the same door #33325's 403 page links, and a GET with no `id_token_hint` lands on the vendor's confirm page, so the link is not a one-click cross-site logout. The scheme check keeps a `javascript:`-shaped `cloudUrl` out of an `href`. Off the control plane no link is drawn rather than a wrong one — correct for the card, since the D5.1 gate that sends this code only runs on the control plane's provider.

Public-surface changes:
4. `ssoCallbackRefusal.ts` gains exports `accessDeniedExits`, `AccessDeniedExits`, `ACCESS_DENIED_CODE`, `CONTROL_PLANE_END_SESSION_PATH`. **Right, not public**: `@object-ui/console`'s `exports` map names only `./plugin.js` (files: `dist`, `plugin.*`, `README.md`), so these are module-internal; the PR's "No new export from any package" holds.
5. Symbols the diff consumes exist on the head: `AUTH_LINK_CLASS` (`@object-ui/auth`), `getRuntimeConfig` (`@object-ui/app-shell` index), `features.cloudManaged` (`@object-ui/auth` `types.ts`, mirroring the spec's `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema`). **Right**; `Type Check UI` is still running and is the authority on it.
6. File surface vs the claim (6883354532): `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/`, the eleven `@object-ui/i18n` packs, one `.changeset/` file. **Right**: exact match; no server, plugin-auth or `packages/spec` path.
7. Tests: `LoginPage.access-denied-32992.test.tsx` drives the real `LoginPage` (4 cases incl. a CONTROL), with three committed-fix ablations reported red as expected. Its relative `packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config` and `packages/types/src/http-inflight` imports follow existing console tests (`AuthLayout.powered-by.test.tsx`, `runtimeConfigBootDedup.test.ts`). **Right**.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):
- `ACCESS_DENIED_CODE` and `CONTROL_PLANE_END_SESSION_PATH` are exported but have no importer outside the module.
- The end-session path is composed from `cloudUrl` plus the fixed `/api/v1/auth` mount and was not measured against cloud staging (the PR says so); worth one manual click on staging after release.
- `access_denied` from a consent decline would read slightly off; disclosed in the PR, and environment clients skip consent.

Check-runs on the head, at review time (60 total):
- success (11): Check Changeset (run 43640537837), Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, filter, Type Check · workspace, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build UI Deps, Plan Test UI shards, Auto Label.
- skipped (17): path-filtered or opt-in lanes (Build Core, Test Core shards, Dogfood shards and Verify CLI, UI Published Artifacts, Build Docs, Temporal Conformance, Plan Test Core shards, Queue verdict, Borrowed queue verdict, Schedule gate, 18.x upgrade harness ×2, Packed-tarball smoke ×2, plus the re-run's Auto Label and Check PR Size).
- **pending (32, in_progress)**: Test UI 1–16/16, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset (re-run 43640687307), Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger.
- failure: none.
This verdict covers the contract; it does not stand in for the 32 pending gates, which the queue reads on their own.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/32992-access-denied-sign-in-return.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch. **Right**: both packages are released (fixed group in `.changeset/config.json`) and both are moved by the diff, so a changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` would be wrong; `Metadata-protocol: none` (no authorable metadata changes), and under AGENTS.md's rule a non-protocol change, widening included, ships `patch`. No other released package is touched.

`Clause-②:` — PR body says `yes (widening)`, the changeset body says `yes (widening)` with the four keys named, and the ui claim declared the same. **Right**: the only published-surface change is four added keys per `@object-ui/i18n` pack; nothing renamed, removed or tightened, so no `(narrowing)` arm, no BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 disposition are owed. `Check Changeset` (first run) is green; its re-run is pending.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions` (ui report 6884148625): `[]` — nothing to answer.
- Area-A1's earlier open question (6880957824: fold the env-side Console half into #33325, or a follow-up): **answered** — option A in effect; A1 released the card to `domain:ui` (6882117393) and this PR is that half on the same card. `Fixes #32992` is right: acceptance 2 landed with #33325, acceptance 3 and the browser-facing half of acceptance 1 land here.
- `out_of_scope_findings` 1 (one-click switch account needs the environment's client registered with `enable_end_session` and a `post_logout_redirect_uri`, plus the client id served to the page; "noted, not filed", carrier would be cloud + server lane): **escalated to the seat** — not a defect of this PR (the two-step switch is disclosed in the UI hint and the PR), but a UX follow-up the seat should either file (cloud carrier, server-lane half) or record as declined; it should not stay unrecorded.
- `out_of_scope_findings` 2 (off the control plane the page cannot address the refusing provider, so no Switch account): **answered** — correct by design, no pull measured beyond this card, nothing to file.
- `security_findings: none` — concur: the only new `href`s come from server-served `cloudUrl` behind an `http(s)` scheme check, the new-tab link carries `noopener noreferrer`, and the logout door requires a confirm POST.
- `dogfood_battery: n/a` — concur: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对

Verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `77593a13` · 2026-11-14T21:21Z

1. **Shape.** Draft → `main`, `Fixes #32992`. 15 files, +319/−2, all on the claimed surface (6883354532):
   - `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/` (`ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`, `LoginPage`, a new rendered test)
   - the eleven `@object-ui/i18n` locale packs (four keys each)
   - one root changeset (`@object-ui/console`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch)
2. **Premise.** On a return from #33325's refused navigation, `?error=access_denied` now reads its own sentence: the account has no access to this environment.
   - On a `cloudManaged` environment with an absolute `http(s)` runtime `cloudUrl`, two links follow it:
     - **Switch account** opens the control plane's `/api/v1/auth/oauth2/end-session` in a new tab. With no `id_token_hint`, that lands on the vendor's confirm page, which really ends the provider session. It is the same door #33325's 403 page links.
     - **Back to console** goes to `cloudUrl`.
   - Elsewhere the page shows the sentence only. That is right for the card: the D5.1 gate that sends this code only runs on the control plane's provider.
   - CONTROL: `invalid_provider` keeps the generic sentence. Three ablations are red.
3. **Contract record.** PASS 6884203093 on this head (`TIER_DEFAULT`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: four additive keys per pack; the new `ssoCallbackRefusal` exports are module-internal, since console's `exports` names only `./plugin.js`). `needs:contract-review` removed.
4. **Gates on head `77593a13`.**
   - All 66 check runs are `success` or `skipped`, including Test UI (16 shards + aggregate), Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard and PR-body guards.
   - `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 33436`: NOT governed, 321 lines ≤ 3000.
   - The dev's local `--ran`: 38/38 exit 0.
5. **The record's escalation, answered by the seat: declined, not filed.** The dev's out-of-scope note says a one-click Switch account would need the environment's client registered with `enable_end_session` and `post_logout_redirect_uri`, a cloud/server change.
   - Today's link already ends the provider session through the vendor's confirm page; one click more is not a defect.
   - No report asks for the one-click form, and under the startup-focus axis a new cloud registration needs a named pull. It is recorded here and not carded.
6. **Accepted nits.**
   - `ACCESS_DENIED_CODE` and `CONTROL_PLANE_END_SESSION_PATH` are exported with no importer.
   - The end-session URL (`cloudUrl` + fixed `/api/v1/auth`) has not been clicked against cloud staging; worth one manual check after release.
   - An `access_denied` from a declined consent screen would read slightly off; the PR discloses it.
7. **K.** 13 first-parent commits since base `bd439f17` < 15, so no base sync.
8. **Out of scope.** None.
9. **Authority.** Landing under the maintainer's standing authorisation 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z).
